parameters.jsCode: const n=$input.all().filter(i=>i.json.job_id).length; const p=$('Claim: Pick').first().json; if(!n) return [{json:{status:200,body:{ok:true,job:null,note:'raced; poll again'}}}]; return [{json:{status:200,body:p.body}}];

const r=$input.all().map(i=>i.json).find(x=>x.job_id); if(!r) return [{json:{status:409,body:{ok:false,cancel:true,reason:'not the running owner of this job (cancelled, finished or requeued)'}}}];
return [{json:{status:200,body:{ok:true,cancel:!!r.cancel_requested}}}];

const d=$('Complete: Decide').first().json; const n=$input.all().filter(i=>i.json.job_id).length; if(!n) return [{json:{status:409,body:{ok:false,reason:'job changed while updating'}}}];
return [{json:{status:200,body:{ok:true,state:d.final_state},notify:d.notify}}];

const d=$('Fail: Decide').first().json; const n=$input.all().filter(i=>i.json.job_id).length; if(!n) return [{json:{status:409,body:{ok:false,reason:'job changed while updating'}}}];
return [{json:{status:200,body:{ok:true,state:d.final_state},notify:d.notify}}];
